F0 tracker for melody adherence: SwiftF0 0.3.0 (MIT code and MIT-labelled ONNX trained on a CC BY-NC-SA dataset; Python 3.8-3.14) with librosa pYIN (ISC, no weights) as a weights-free cross-check; torchcrepe and PESTO secondary. Note transcriber: Basic Pitch is the only clean-weights option with any humming number (onset+pitch F1 0.27-0.43, no offsets, COMMUNITY) and needs Python 3.10 or a --no-deps CoreML/ONNX install on macOS. SOME, GAME and ROSVOT fail the weights-license test. Ticket: local benchmark on Jon's hums plus HumTrans (CC BY-NC, personal evaluation only) scoring COn/COnP/COnPOff with mir_eval: Basic Pitch vs SwiftF0.segment_notes vs pYIN+HMM.
claims.notes: Gap research, verifier confidence high. No skeptic pass.

claims.statement: YuE2 accepts a caller-supplied melody/chord ABC plus lyrics without SheetSage2, and renders it exactly.
claims.verified_answer: The user-ABC path is native (abc= with cot 'full' or 'melody'); SheetSage2/MERT2 are not loaded. It is conditioning, not exact rendering (84.17% exact pitch on edited model-generated scores, VENDOR). Converter must emit the strict two-voice dialect: fixed header, one integer tempo, full bars, no tuplets or pickups, sections as % comments. Lyrics bind only by section tags and order. About 6 min maximum. zh and en only.
claims.notes: Gap research, verifier confidence high. No skeptic pass.

claims.statement: YuE2 needs a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU, so 16 GB cards do not qualify, and it runs on native Windows.
claims.verified_answer: 24 GB is a vendor recommendation; vendor NVML peaks are 11.2 GiB typical and 14.1 GiB at maximum context. 16 GB cards are plausible but unvalidated on the PyTorch path (the pipeline caps PyTorch at about 14 GiB on a 16 GB card; levers --budget <=12, --quantization fp8, --offload-ar) and comfortable through GGUF ports (COMMUNITY). Native Windows is broken on main with official wheels (CPU-only torch wheel on PyPI, FlashAttention stub, PR #166 open; NAR MATH-SDPA fallback ~6x slower and +7 GB per #209). WSL2 with the Windows NVIDIA driver is the practical Windows route if .wslconfig memory is raised to >=24 GB (default is 50% of RAM). Drivers: >=570.26 Linux / >=570.65 Windows for the default cu128 wheel; R580+ for cu130. BF16 required (Ampere or newer in practice).
claims.notes: Gap research, verifier confidence high. No skeptic pass.

Official YuE2 MPS stays blocked by #176 (fixed only in torch >=2.13; pin PR #190 unmerged) and #187 (open PR). No port publishes Metal-vs-reference parity.

Clones cannot be exported; Eleven v4 / v4 Turbo now top the AA TTS board, so v4 is the bar.
